text:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up — incident DD-482 last week shows a recurring KV eviction under high-concurrency spiky traffic. I want to lock owners and a timeline for tests we agreed on: regression suite addition, new prompt set, a focused load test, and a chaos drill.

Samir: +1. I'm happy to own the regression suite change. Will pick a PR and a JIRA (OPS-1298). ETA two weeks?

Elena: I can own the prompt set and the evals integration. I'll add the failing traces to the promptset repo and create a baseline. ETA 10 days.

Maya: Awesome. Samir, please include a smoke test that reproduces TTL/KV eviction patterns — ideally a synthetic workload that ramps to 12k concurrent connections.

Samir: Yep. Thinking of adding a new job in .circleci/evals.yml and a k8s job for onprem. Rough snippet:```
# new job: kv-eviction-regression
run: go test ./tests/kv_eviction -run EvictSim -concurrency 12000 -duration 5m
```

oncall-bot: Incident DD-482 postmortem link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-482/postmortem (added by oncall-bot)

Elena: For the prompt set I want one 'short path' reproducer and one 'long tail' conversation that hits cache thrashing. I'll push both to https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/promptsets/ and tag @Samir for wiring.

DevOps-Eng: Important: make sure the load test runs from both a single-region and multi-region network topology — the issue only surfaced with cross-region bursts. I can add a GCP config and a multi-region variant.

Maya: Good call. Add a chaos drill too — network flaps and node restarts during the peak of the synthetic load. Proposed drill date: two weeks from now (2029-03-18). Anyone blocked?

Jit: I can schedule the chaos run (using Chaos Toolkit) and be on call for the drill. I'll prepare runbook updates and a rollback checklist.

Samir: One more: add KV metrics to the regression assertions (eviction_rate, cache_hit_ratio). Fail the test if eviction_rate > 0.1 for >30s.

Elena: I'll add example prompts and expected tolerances to the promptset README so the quality checks integrate into the CI gate.

Maya: Ownership recap: Samir -> regression suite + CI job (OPS-1298), Elena -> promptset & evals baseline (OPS-1299), DevOps-Eng -> multi-region load configs, Jit -> chaos drill + runbook. I'll create a parent task and link the child JIRAs.

Samir: Timeline check: I'll open the PR for the CI job by EOD Monday.

Elena: Pushing promptset today, will add labels and link to the postmortem.

Jit: Scheduling the chaos window for 2029-03-18 18:00 UTC, will send calendar invites and a pre-brief an hour before.

Maya: Thanks team. We'll track in the postmortem board and sync in next week's SRE triage if anything slips. Please ping here when PRs and tickets are created. :white_check_mark: :eyes:

DevOps-Eng: One last note — add a canary variant to the Dedicated model routing that falls back to a smaller cache or different eviction policy during overload. That might reduce blast radius while we fix root cause.

Samir: Noted. I'll prototype a fallback toggle behind a feature flag in the routing layer.

Maya: Great. Closing for now. If anyone sees a blocker, escalate to the incident channel. (reacts :thumbsup:)
